concepts.gloss_en: The imaginative/imaginary faculty (the koach ha-medameh) itself — the mental power associated with dreams, kelipot, Pharaoh
The RECTIFICATION of the imaginative faculty (a process/state about the koach ha-medameh, not the faculty itself)

members.note: rectification of the medameh; tikkun ha-medameh via the lung/prophecy
same rectification; 'koach ha-medameh' fully spelled vs elided 'medameh', same lm2:8 context and referent

concepts.gloss_en: The rectification of BOTH the imagination and faith — a compound construct head that also includes emunah; distinct from tikkun of the medameh alone

members.note: compound object (medameh + emunah); different construct head per rule 4

notes: Per rule 4, an action/state about X (tikkun) is not X, so כח המדמה is kept separate from its tikkun. The two-part 'המדמה והאמונה' has a different (compound) construct head and is kept separate from the simple 'תקון המדמה'. תקון המדמה and תקון כח המדמה are merged as likely (elided vs full 'koach'), same Torah lm2:8 and same referent.
